items.title_en: Probe ordered into police action against protesting Bhopal intern doctors
items.title_hi: Probe ordered into police action against protesting Bhopal intern doctors
items.detail_en: On Monday, September 7, hundreds of interns of the GMC, Bhopal, protested at their campus over their longstanding demand that their stipend be increased from the current ₹14,437 to ₹30,000.
